```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(nlmixr2lib)
library(rxode2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Model and source

* Citation: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("Schlachter_2026b_atogepant"))$reference`
* Description: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("Schlachter_2026b_atogepant"))$description`
* Article: <https://doi.org/10.1002/psp4.70154> (open access; Data S1 holds the
  NONMEM control stream)

This is the exposure-response companion of the atogepant population PK model
`Schlachter_2026_atogepant` (Clin Pharmacokinet 2026), which supplied the
individual steady-state trough concentrations this model takes as input. The
two papers share a first author, year and drug, so this one is filed as
`Schlachter_2026b_atogepant`.

# Population

The analysis pooled 2544 adults with migraine from four randomised,
placebo-controlled 12-week trials (Schlachter 2026 Table 1): the phase 2b/3
episodic-migraine (EM) dose-ranging study (N = 795), the phase 3 EM study
ADVANCE (N = 873), the phase 3 chronic-migraine (CM) study PROGRESS (N = 596)
and the phase 3 EM study ELEVATE (N = 280), whose patients had all failed two
to four classes of conventional oral migraine preventive treatments. 1948
patients (76%) had EM and 596 (23%) CM. Age was 18-74 years (median 41),
body weight 35.8-226 kg (median 76.2), 88% were female, and 78% White, 12%
Black and 8% Asian (31% of the CM study). Baseline monthly migraine days (MMD)
had a median of 9.00 (range 3.23-28.0). Treatment arms were placebo (792),
atogepant 10 mg QD (306), 30 mg QD (405), 60 mg QD (703), 30 mg BID (251) and
60 mg BID (87).

The same information is available programmatically:

```{r population}
str(readModelDb("Schlachter_2026b_atogepant")()$population)
```

# Model structure

With `C` the individual steady-state atogepant trough concentration (nM) and
`BSL` the individual baseline MMD (Data S1 `$PRED`):

* combined effect on a shifted-logit scale:
  `eff = pbo + eta_pbo + cov` in placebo patients and
  `eff = pbo + (emax + b_emax (BSL - 9) + eta_emax) C / (C + EC50) + cov` in
  atogepant patients, with `cov` the additive failed-treatment and Asian-race
  shifts;
* back-transform to a shift in (-1, 1): `E1 = 2 exp(eff) / (1 + exp(eff)) - 1`;
* time to half effect: `T50 = theta exp(b_t50 (BSL - 9) + b_fail FAIL)`;
* prediction: `MMD(t) = BSL (1 - E1 (1 - exp(-t log(2) / T50)))`, with time in
  months;
* additive normal residual error with a separate variance for EM and CM.

# Source trace

| Equation / parameter | Value | Source location |
|----------------------|-------|-----------------|
| `ec50` | 0.412 nM | Table 4 'Atogepant Cmin EC50'; Data S1 THETA(1) |
| `pbo` | 0.852 | Table 4 'Placebo effect'; Data S1 THETA(2) |
| `lt50` | log(0.407 month) | Table 4 'TEF50 (month)'; Data S1 THETA(3) |
| `emax` | 0.665 | Table 4 'Atogepant Cmin Emax'; Data S1 THETA(4) |
| `e_migraine_days_bl_emax` | -0.0166 per day/month | Table 4 'Baseline MMD on atogepant Emax'; Data S1 THETA(5) |
| `e_migraine_oral_preventive_ir_eff` | -0.410 | Table 4 'Previously failed treatments on combined placebo & atogepant effect'; Data S1 THETA(6) |
| `e_migraine_days_bl_t50` | log(1.02) per day/month | Table 4 'Baseline MMD on TEF50' (printed as exp(THETA(7))) |
| `e_migraine_oral_preventive_ir_t50` | log(0.628) | Table 4 'Previously failed treatments on TEF50' (printed as exp(THETA(8))) |
| `e_race_asian_eff` | -0.326 | Table 4 'Asian race on combined placebo & atogepant effect'; Data S1 THETA(9) |
| `etapbo` | 0.793 (variance) | Table 4 'IIV on placebo effect' (110 %CV) |
| `etaemax` | 1.67 (variance) | Table 4 'IIV on atogepant Emax' (208 %CV) |
| `addSdEpisodic` | sqrt(3.34) days/month | Table 4 'Additive error episodic (days2)' |
| `addSdChronic` | sqrt(7.98) days/month | Table 4 'Additive error chronic (days2)' |
| Combined effect, back-transform, time course | n/a | Methods 2.2.1 equations; Data S1 `$PRED` |
| Placebo-only branch with `ETA(1)` | n/a | Data S1 `IF (TRT .EQ. 0) EFF = LGPEFF + ETA(1) + EFFCOV` |
| Centring of baseline MMD at 9.00 | n/a | Data S1 `BSL - 9.00`; Table 1 pooled median |
| Compression of simulated MMD into 0-28 | n/a | Methods 2.2.2 'Normal' |

Two Table 4 rows are printed on the exponentiated scale. For 'Previously
failed treatments on TEF50' the 95% CI (0.513, 0.768) is symmetric about
log(0.628) on the log scale, and the Data S1 initial estimates (0.02 and -0.4
for THETA(7) and THETA(8)) are on the log scale, so both rows are
`exp(theta)` and are encoded here as `log(1.02)` and `log(0.628)`.

# Closed-form checks

The model is algebraic (no ODEs), so the typical-value prediction can be
checked against the published equations evaluated by hand with the same
parameter values. Both sides use identical inputs, so the bound is tight.

```{r closed-form}
mod <- readModelDb("Schlachter_2026b_atogepant")()
# Zero the between-subject variances. The residual SDs are ini() thetas, not
# sigmas, so there is nothing to zero there; `migraine_days` is the
# prediction without residual error either way.
mod_typ <- rxode2::zeroRe(mod, "omega")

# A solve with every omega at zero warns that a multi-subject simulation has
# no omega; that expected warning is muffled and any other still surfaces.
solve_typical <- function(...) {
  withCallingHandlers(
    as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(mod_typ, ..., returnType = "data.frame")),
    warning = function(w) {
      if (grepl("without 'omega'", conditionMessage(w))) {
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    }
  )
}

grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL = c(4, 9, 19, 28),
  CTROUGH = c(0, 4.34, 28.9, 167),
  MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR = c(0, 1),
  RACE_ASIAN = c(0, 1),
  time = c(0, 0.5, 1, 3)
) |>
  mutate(
    PLACEBO = as.integer(CTROUGH == 0),
    DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC = as.integer(MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL >= 15),
    id = dplyr::row_number(),
    evid = 0L,
    amt = 0
  )

typ <- solve_typical(events = grid)

hand <- grid |>
  mutate(
    bl_c = MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL - 9,
    eff = 0.852 +
      (1 - PLACEBO) * (0.665 - 0.0166 * bl_c) * CTROUGH / (CTROUGH + 0.412) -
      0.410 * MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR - 0.326 * RACE_ASIAN,
    e1 = 2 * exp(eff) / (1 + exp(eff)) - 1,
    t50 = 0.407 * 1.02^bl_c * 0.628^MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR,
    mmd = MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL * (1 - e1 * (1 - exp(-time * log(2) / t50)))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(typ) == nrow(hand))
max_abs_diff <- max(abs(typ$migraine_days - hand$mmd))
max_abs_diff
stopifnot(max_abs_diff < 1e-8)

# At time 0 the prediction is the individual baseline exactly.
stopifnot(all(abs(typ$migraine_days[grid$time == 0] -
  grid$MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL[grid$time == 0]) < 1e-10))
```

The abstract and Discussion quote a model-based trough EC90 of 3.71 nM. For a
hyperbolic Emax the EC90 is 9 x EC50:

```{r ec90}
ec90 <- 9 * 0.412
ec90
stopifnot(abs(ec90 - 3.71) < 0.005)
```

# Replication of Figure S2: MMD at Week 9-12 versus trough concentration

Figure S2 plots the predicted MMD at Week 9-12 against the atogepant trough,
for the mean EM and the mean CM baseline, with failed treatments and Asian race
set to "no". The mean EM baseline is the patient-weighted mean of the three EM
studies in Table 1; the CM mean is the PROGRESS mean.

```{r figS2}
bsl_em <- (795 * 7.67 + 873 * 7.65 + 280 * 9.14) / 1948
bsl_cm <- 19.0

conc_grid <- c(0, seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.05), seq(1.5, 100, by = 0.5))
s2_events <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  population = c("Episodic migraine", "Chronic migraine"),
  CTROUGH = conc_grid
) |>
  mutate(
    MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL = ifelse(population == "Episodic migraine", bsl_em, bsl_cm),
    DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC = as.integer(population == "Chronic migraine"),
    PLACEBO = 0L,
    MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR = 0L,
    RACE_ASIAN = 0L,
    id = dplyr::row_number(),
    time = 3,
    evid = 0L,
    amt = 0
  )

s2 <- solve_typical(events = s2_events, keep = c("population", "CTROUGH"))

ggplot(s2, aes(CTROUGH, migraine_days)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ec90, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(population, c("Episodic migraine", "Chronic migraine")),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Steady-state atogepant trough concentration (nM)",
    y = "Monthly migraine days at Week 9-12",
    caption = "Replicates the median line of Figure S2 of Schlachter 2026; dashed line = EC90."
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

The published curve was digitised by the maintainers from the 400-dpi
rendering of the supplement, locating the axis ticks and the line centre by
pixel colour (reading resolution about 0.02 MMD for EM and 0.07 MMD for CM).

```{r figS2-compare}
s2_ref <- tibble::tribble(
  ~population, ~CTROUGH, ~published,
  "Episodic migraine", 0, 4.69,
  "Episodic migraine", 50, 2.85,
  "Chronic migraine", 0, 11.5,
  "Chronic migraine", 50, 8.47
)

s2_cmp <- s2_ref |>
  left_join(s2 |> select(population, CTROUGH, migraine_days),
    by = c("population", "CTROUGH")
  ) |>
  mutate(pct_diff = 100 * (migraine_days - published) / published)

s2_cmp |>
  mutate(migraine_days = round(migraine_days, 2), pct_diff = round(pct_diff, 1)) |>
  rename(
    "Population" = population,
    "Trough (nM)" = CTROUGH,
    "Figure S2 (digitised)" = published,
    "Model, typical value" = migraine_days,
    "Difference (%)" = pct_diff
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

# The two placebo-level points and the EM plateau are gated; the CM plateau is
# a known deviation (see Assumptions and deviations) and is reported only.
gated <- s2_cmp |>
  filter(!(population == "Chronic migraine" & CTROUGH == 50))
stopifnot(all(abs(gated$pct_diff) < 3))
```

The curve plateaus within a few nM of zero, as the paper reports: the trough
of most 10 mg QD patients (Table 2 median 4.34 nM) already exceeds the
3.71 nM EC90. The placebo-level intercepts and the EM plateau agree with the
figure to within 1%. The CM plateau is about 5% below the figure; see
Assumptions and deviations.

# Virtual cohort

Observed data are not public. The cohort below mirrors the arms of Figure 3 of
the paper, capped at 200 patients per arm. Within each arm:

* the baseline MMD is drawn from a normal distribution with the Table 1 mean
  and SD of the contributing studies, truncated to the Table 1 range;
* the trough concentration is drawn from a log-normal distribution whose
  median and 5th-95th percentile span match Table 2 for that regimen (0 for
  placebo);
* in EM placebo and EM 60 mg QD arms, a share of patients equal to the
  ELEVATE share of that arm in Table 1 are failed-treatment patients, with the
  ELEVATE baseline distribution;
* Asian race is drawn at the Table 1 rate of the contributing studies (1.2% for
  phase 2b/3 + ADVANCE, 1.4% for ELEVATE, 30.5% for PROGRESS).

```{r cohort}
set.seed(20261120)
rxode2::rxSetSeed(20261120)

# Table 2: median (5th, 95th percentile) steady-state trough, nM.
cmin_tab <- tibble::tribble(
  ~arm, ~med, ~p05, ~p95,
  "Placebo", 0, 0, 0,
  "10 mg QD", 4.34, 1.94, 10.2,
  "30 mg QD", 14.7, 7.32, 34.3,
  "60 mg QD", 28.9, 10.2, 67.0,
  "30 mg BID", 72.9, 33.1, 236,
  "60 mg BID", 167, 69.4, 480
)

# Table 1 arm sizes; n_fail = ELEVATE patients in that EM arm.
arms <- tibble::tribble(
  ~indication, ~arm, ~n_table1, ~n_fail,
  "Episodic migraine", "Placebo", 178 + 214 + 154, 154,
  "Episodic migraine", "10 mg QD", 92 + 214, 0,
  "Episodic migraine", "30 mg QD", 182 + 223, 0,
  "Episodic migraine", "60 mg QD", 177 + 222 + 126, 126,
  "Episodic migraine", "30 mg BID", 79, 0,
  "Episodic migraine", "60 mg BID", 87, 0,
  "Chronic migraine", "Placebo", 246, 0,
  "Chronic migraine", "60 mg QD", 178, 0,
  "Chronic migraine", "30 mg BID", 172, 0
) |>
  mutate(n = pmin(n_table1, 200L))

rtnorm <- function(n, mean, sd, lo, hi) {
  qnorm(runif(n, pnorm(lo, mean, sd), pnorm(hi, mean, sd)), mean, sd)
}

make_arm <- function(indication, arm, n, n_table1, n_fail, id_offset) {
  cm <- indication == "Chronic migraine"
  fail <- rbinom(n, 1, n_fail / n_table1)
  bsl <- if (cm) {
    rtnorm(n, 19.0, 4.96, 8, 28)
  } else {
    ifelse(fail == 1,
      rtnorm(n, 9.14, 2.37, 4, 14),
      rtnorm(n, 7.66, 2.43, 3.23, 16.2)
    )
  }
  asian_p <- if (cm) 182 / 596 else ifelse(fail == 1, 4 / 280, 20 / 1668)
  ct <- cmin_tab[cmin_tab$arm == arm, ]
  cmin <- if (ct$med == 0) {
    rep(0, n)
  } else {
    exp(rnorm(n, log(ct$med), (log(ct$p95) - log(ct$p05)) / (2 * qnorm(0.95))))
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    id = id_offset + seq_len(n),
    indication = indication,
    arm = arm,
    MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL = bsl,
    DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC = as.integer(cm),
    MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR = fail,
    RACE_ASIAN = rbinom(n, 1, asian_p),
    CTROUGH = cmin,
    PLACEBO = as.integer(arm == "Placebo")
  )
}

arm_args <- dplyr::mutate(arms, id_offset = cumsum(c(0L, head(n, -1L))))
subjects <- dplyr::bind_rows(Map(
  make_arm,
  arm_args$indication, arm_args$arm, arm_args$n,
  arm_args$n_table1, arm_args$n_fail, arm_args$id_offset
))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(subjects$id), all(table(subjects$id) == 1))

# Observations at baseline and at Weeks 1-4, 5-8 and 9-12 (months 1, 2, 3).
events <- subjects |>
  tidyr::crossing(time = 0:3) |>
  mutate(evid = 0L, amt = 0) |>
  arrange(id, time)

subjects |>
  group_by(indication, arm) |>
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    `baseline MMD (median)` = round(median(MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL), 2),
    `trough nM (median)` = round(median(CTROUGH), 1),
    `failed treatments (%)` = round(100 * mean(MIGRAINE_ORAL_PREVENTIVE_IR)),
    `Asian (%)` = round(100 * mean(RACE_ASIAN)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Simulation and replication of Figure 3

The simulated observation is compressed as in the paper (Methods 2.2.2): values
below 0 become 0 and above 28 become 28, and at baseline EM values are held to
4-14 and CM values to at least 8.

```{r simulate}
sim <- as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(mod,
  events = events,
  keep = c("indication", "arm", "MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL", "DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC"),
  returnType = "data.frame"
)) |>
  mutate(
    mmd = pmin(pmax(sim, 0), 28),
    mmd = dplyr::case_when(
      time == 0 & DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC == 0 ~ pmin(pmax(mmd, 4), 14),
      time == 0 & DIS_MIGRAINE_CHRONIC == 1 ~ pmax(mmd, 8),
      TRUE ~ mmd
    ),
    cfb = mmd - MIGRAINE_DAYS_BL,
    arm = factor(arm, cmin_tab$arm),
    indication = factor(indication, c("Episodic migraine", "Chronic migraine")),
    visit = factor(time, 0:3, c("Baseline", "Week 1-4", "Week 5-8", "Week 9-12"))
  )

vpc <- sim |>
  group_by(indication, arm, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p05 = quantile(mmd, 0.05), p50 = median(mmd), p95 = quantile(mmd, 0.95),
    c05 = quantile(cfb, 0.05), c50 = median(cfb), c95 = quantile(cfb, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(vpc, aes(visit, p50, group = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p05, ymax = p95), alpha = 0.25, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(indication ~ arm) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 28), breaks = seq(0, 28, 7)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Monthly migraine days",
    caption = "Replicates Figure 3A of Schlachter 2026 (simulated median and 5th-95th percentiles)."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

ggplot(vpc, aes(visit, c50, group = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = c05, ymax = c95), alpha = 0.25, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(indication ~ arm) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Change from baseline in monthly migraine days",
    caption = "Replicates Figure 3B of Schlachter 2026 (simulated median and 5th-95th percentiles)."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
```

The simulated medians follow the shape of the published VPC: most of the
reduction arrives by Weeks 1-4 (the typical T50 is 0.41 month at 9 baseline
MMD). In Figure 3A the Week 9-12 medians are roughly 3 MMD in the active EM
arms against about 4.5-5 on placebo, and roughly 8.5-10 in the active CM arms
against about 12.5 on placebo. The table below gives the simulated values. The
EM arms and the active CM arms land in the same range. The CM placebo median
comes out about one MMD higher than in the figure. This virtual cohort
reconstructs baseline, race and trough distributions from summary tables, so
it is not the trial dataset.

```{r week12-table}
sim |>
  filter(time == 3) |>
  group_by(indication, arm) |>
  summarise(
    `median MMD` = round(median(mmd), 2),
    `median change from baseline` = round(median(cfb), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename("Indication" = indication, "Arm" = arm) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Why no PKNCA section

This is an exposure-response model with no dosing and no concentration time
course: the atogepant exposure enters as a per-patient steady-state trough
supplied as data. Non-compartmental analysis does not apply, so validation uses
the closed-form check, the EC90 identity and the replication of Figures S2 and
3 above. To drive the model from doses instead, simulate steady-state troughs
with `modellib("Schlachter_2026_atogepant")` and convert ng/mL to nM with the
atogepant molar mass of 603.5 g/mol.

# Assumptions and deviations

- **Direction of the failed-treatment effect on T50.** Table 4 prints the
  failed-treatment effect on TEF50 as 0.628 (95% CI 0.513-0.768), a
  multiplier below 1, so failed-treatment patients reach half the combined
  effect sooner; Table S2 (the M3-like sensitivity fit) gives 0.673, also below
  1. The Discussion and Abstract instead say that these patients have a longer
  time to half effect. The maintainers encoded the tabulated value (Table 4,
  Table S2 and the Data S1 code all agree); the baseline-MMD half of the same
  sentence agrees with the table.
- **Exponentiated table rows.** 'Baseline MMD on TEF50' (1.02) and
  'Previously failed treatments on TEF50' (0.628) are read as `exp(theta)`
  because their confidence intervals are symmetric on the log scale and the
  Data S1 initial estimates are on the log scale. The 1.02 value is printed to
  two decimals, so the per-day effect on T50 carries a rounding uncertainty of
  about +/-0.5% per baseline migraine day.
- **Compression is post-processing.** The final model was estimated with the
  compressed normal distribution: a plain normal likelihood with predictions
  outside 0-28 (and baseline values outside the EM 4-14 and CM >= 8 ranges)
  set to the boundary. The model file therefore returns the unclamped normal
  simulation; the clamp is applied in this article.
- **Figure S2 CM plateau.** The model's typical prediction for a CM patient at
  19 baseline MMD on a high trough is 8.0 MMD at Week 9-12, while the
  digitised Figure S2 curve sits at about 8.5. The EM curve and both
  zero-concentration intercepts agree within 2%, and no reading of the visit
  time or baseline value reproduces all four points at once. The source does
  not say how the median line was summarised beyond "the means of the
  population predicted MMD" over 10,000 parameter-uncertainty draws, which
  is the likely origin of the gap. The model parameters were not adjusted.
- **Placebo random effect only in placebo patients.** Following Data S1, the
  placebo-effect random effect applies only to placebo patients and the Emax
  random effect only to atogepant patients.
- **Table 4 %CV column.** Table 4 reports the IIV as `sqrt(exp(omega^2) - 1)`,
  a log-normal convention, although both random effects are additive on the
  shifted-logit scale (Data S1 `; ETA(1): add`). The variances 0.793 and 1.67
  are used as printed.
- **Residual error.** Table 4 gives the additive residual variances in days^2
  (3.34 EM, 7.98 CM); the model uses their square roots as standard
  deviations.
- **Visit times.** Observations are placed at months 0, 1, 2 and 3 for
  baseline and Weeks 1-4, 5-8 and 9-12, matching the time axis of Figure 3
  and the month unit of TEF50.
- **Confounding of the failed-treatment covariate.** All 280 failed-treatment
  patients came from ELEVATE and no other study enrolled any (Table 1), so
  the covariate cannot be separated from a study effect.
- **Virtual cohort.** Baseline MMD and trough distributions are reconstructed
  from Table 1 summaries and Table 2 percentiles (normal and log-normal shapes
  assumed). Trough concentrations are drawn independently of baseline MMD.
- **Covariates screened and not retained.** Prior preventive migraine
  medication (removed in backward elimination at p = 0.00223), body weight,
  sex and age are listed in `covariatesDataExcluded` of the model.
- **Literature check.** No erratum or correction notice for the paper was found
  as of 2026-11-20.
